// forms the checker rejects in TypeScript, reachable from JavaScript
function t(name, f) {
  try {
    console.log(name, f());
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(name, e.name + ": " + e.message);
  }
}
const one = 1n;
const n = 1;
t("eqn", () => [one == n, one == 1.5, 2n ** 64n == 2 ** 64, n != one, one === n, one !== n]);
t("cmp", () => [one < 1.5, 2 > one, one >= NaN]);
